gates: fixed one-hot source latent-block identity for every input cell; no new gate discovery
anchor: reviewed CM45 shared mixture and its identical91-map context bank
diagnostic: same original-order source-excluded CM45 diagnostic, canonical complete conjugate head at margin24, full raw-vocabulary ordinary cross-entropy
caveat: latent discovery uses all training records; source exclusion is not a refit. Local canonical CE training is transferred to the unchanged actual head; no unseen-label guarantee
initialization: for each gate, keep the anchor local row unless an anchored bank vertex lowers that gate's mean diagnostic CE by more than1e-10; increasing bank-index ties, original record multiplicities; empty groups keep anchor
full: start from local initialization;64 conditional-gradient steps on all original records; one minimizing vertex per active gate, shared line step; retain best complete diagnostic epoch
mini: same initialization;8 epochs in original order with the inherited actual minibatch size and short tails; absent gates unchanged; retain best complete diagnostic epoch
forward: local anchored vertex initialization only; zero new derivatives and optimizer updates
applicability: same previously interpolated unseen ambiguous matched rows as CM45; other rows use the exact reviewed parent
inference: effective per-group weights=(1-radius)*anchor+radius*local; mix actual complex source features then apply every original real/imaginary head coefficient
binding: external CM45 model digest; deterministic reconstruction of fixed gates,anchor,radius,local optimization,actual rows and complete costs
original_comparison: separate after component review; all35 tasks,both policies,full/mini/forward,unchanged baselines and all raw-label/CE regressions; seal before heldout scoring
